======== ABC command line "version"
UC Berkeley, ABC 1.01 (compiled Sep  9 2026 05:28:12)

area_crosscheck.primary: sum of JSON top cell counts times Liberty cell areas
area_crosscheck.reason: allow finite textual precision in Yosys stat, not physical variation

contract.fcw: programmable input; not constant-folded per scenario
contract.repeat_hash_definition: sorted top port/cell connectivity, types and parameters; excludes instance names, source attributes and wire labels; retains Yosys signal IDs; not an equivalence proof
contract.scope: fixed development candidates; full-DDC mapped cell area
contract.script:
read_liberty -lib ../cells.lib
read_verilog -sv design.v
hierarchy -check -top top
synth -top top -flatten -noabc
dffunmap
dfflibmap -liberty ../cells.lib
abc -exe "/opt/homebrew/Cellar/yosys/0.69/bin/yosys-abc" -liberty ../cells.lib
clean
delete t:$scopeinfo
check -mapped -assert
tee -o stat.json stat -json -liberty ../cells.lib -top top
write_json mapped.json
